content.user_title: Build Spring Boot Apps With Best Practices
content.value_statement: Spring Boot teams need consistent guidance for structure, configuration, testing, and security. This skill gives focused best practices for building maintainable Java services.
actual_capabilities: Recommends Maven or Gradle project setup and Spring Boot starters.
Guides package organization by feature or domain.
Explains constructor injection, immutable dependencies, and Spring component stereotypes.
Covers configuration, profiles, and secrets handling guidance.
Summarizes web, service, data, logging, testing, and security practices.
limitations: It provides guidance only and does not generate a complete project by itself.
It does not inspect repository code unless the user supplies code for review.
It does not replace official Spring documentation or security review.
It focuses on common Spring Boot application patterns, not every Spring ecosystem module.

use_cases.title: Plan a New Backend Service
use_cases.description: Use the skill to choose package structure, dependencies, configuration files, and baseline testing practices before coding starts.

use_cases.title: Review Spring Boot Code
use_cases.description: Use the checklist to assess controllers, services, repositories, logging, validation, and security practices in an existing project.

use_cases.title: Standardize Team Guidance
use_cases.description: Use the recommendations as a concise reference for consistent Spring Boot conventions across Java services.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Service
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me plan a new Spring Boot service. Recommend package structure, starters, configuration files, and the first tests to add.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Controller
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Spring Boot controller for DTO usage, validation, error handling, and security concerns. Suggest practical changes.

prompt_templates.title: Improve Data Access
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate my Spring Data JPA approach. Recommend repository patterns, DTO projections, transaction boundaries, and query improvements.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Production Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess this Spring Boot service for production readiness. Focus on configuration, secrets, logging, testing, authentication, and input handling.

output_examples.input: I need a package layout for an orders service.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends grouping by domain, such as order controllers, services, DTOs, and repositories together under one feature package.

output_examples.input: My controller returns JPA entities directly.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends using DTOs at the API boundary and applying validation annotations to incoming request models.

output_examples.input: How should I test my repository and controller layers?
output_examples.output: The skill suggests targeted test slices for controllers and repositories, plus integration tests for full application context behavior.

best_practices: Ask for recommendations against a specific Spring Boot layer or workflow.
Provide relevant code when you want a precise review.
Combine this guidance with current Spring Boot documentation for version-specific details.
anti_patterns: Do not expose JPA entities directly from API controllers.
Do not hardcode secrets in Spring configuration files.
Do not place all classes into layer-only packages without domain grouping.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps apply Spring Boot best practices for project structure, dependency injection, configuration, APIs, data access, logging, testing, and security.

faq.question: Does it create a full Spring Boot project?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and review criteria. You can ask it to help draft project files or review existing code.

faq.question: Can it review my existing Java code?
faq.answer: Yes. Provide the relevant code or file context, then ask for a focused review against Spring Boot practices.

faq.question: Does it cover Spring Security?
faq.answer: Yes. It recommends Spring Security for authentication and authorization, strong password encoding, and safe input handling.

faq.question: Is this guidance version-specific?
faq.answer: No. It gives general Spring Boot practices. Check official documentation for behavior tied to a specific version.
